title: Water shortage in Quezon’s Alabat town disrupts farming, coconut sap production

blocks.text: The town of Alabat, one of three municipalities on Alabat Island in Quezon province, has been grappling with a water shortage for seven months, disrupting drinking water supplies and the livelihoods of farmers, including rice growers and coconut sap producers, Mayor Eizelle Avellano-Canimo said.
